maddeler.e:
يتهاجر (form VI)
# يَتَهَاجَرُ (yatahājaru) /ja.ta.haː.d͡ʒa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَهَاجَرَ (tahājara)
# يُتَهَاجَرُ (yutahājaru) /ju.ta.haː.d͡ʒa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَهَاجَرَ (tahājara)
# يَتَهَاجَرَ (yatahājara) /ja.ta.haː.d͡ʒa.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَهَاجَرَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
